name: Edgardo Rafael Baez
problems: Dropped stance on "Economy and poverty": too long.
notes: 1) Ballot status: He is confirmed on the ballot as 'EDGARDO RAFAEL BAEZ (Republican)' for U.S. Rep. District 20, per the Texas Secretary of State results page and the Click2Houston ballot guide (both seen in search results, not opened). I found no sign he withdrew. Ballotpedia's Castro page also lists an 'Anthony Tristan', but the SOS listing shows only Baez and Castro, so Tristan may be a write-in. 2) Fetch limit: The tool-use limit ran out before I could open the campaign website (drbaezforcongress.com) or the Ballotpedia page. Ballotpedia details (education years, Army 1989–2002, birthplace) come from the search-result snippet. The campaign site is listed only as a source, and no stance cites it. 3) Discrepancies: The San Antonio Report profile says he served 14 years in the Army, while Ballotpedia gives 1989–2002 (about 13 years). An older San Antonio Report GOP voter guide snippet calls him a 'retired physician', but his own questionnaire and other coverage say he was a nurse, so I did not use 'physician'. 4) Residency: The San Antonio Report says he lives in District 23, not District 20. U.S. House candidates are not required to live in their district. His questionnaire says only that he lives in San Antonio. I left this out of the profile. 5) Law license: The San Antonio Report (2026-10-15) says he was sanctioned by the State Bar of Texas for five years, was sued by a former law partner, and once filed for bankruptcy, and it links to State Bar records. I left these out of the history section pending editorial review of how Ballot Atlas handles disciplinary records. 6) Fundraising figures differ by date: the Paisano reported $48,535 raised; the San Antonio Report reported about $66,000 raised, including a $40,000 loan from himself. Both cite FEC ID H6TX20113. 7) The Paisano item is mainly about Castro but includes Baez's positions, so I kept it in the news list. Only three news items from the last 45 days could be verified.
